title: ITR filing help at DigiConnect Dukan
description: Documents you need and common mistakes to avoid when filing your Income Tax Return.

posts.facebook:
ITR file karna hai par documents ka confusion hai? 🤔

Ye 4 cheezein ready rakhiye:
1. PAN aur Aadhaar (linked)
2. Form 16 / salary slips
3. Bank statement
4. Investment proofs (80C, 80D)

Sabse common galti: bank account pre-validate na karna — refund atak jaata hai.

Hum aapka ITR sahi tarike se file karne mein madad karte hain. Details website par 👇
